plugins.name: roxy
plugins.description: A machine your agent edits video on. Ask your coding agent to edit a video, make a TikTok, add captions or render a Remotion project: it uploads the footage to a roxy box with ffmpeg and many CPUs, cuts and renders there, and sends you a link to review the cut.
